name: djxfli_beam90
source: dimmer ch4 + blue/red/green ch8/6/7 confirmed on the unit 2026-10-12; owner read the printed manual chart 2026-10-12 (pan, tilt, XY speed, dimmer, strobe, R, G, B, W, colour auto, motor auto, auto, reset); earlier tests agree: ch10 cycles colours, ch11 moves randomly
notes: Menu: Addr/CHnd 13CH/SLnd (SL 1 = DMX, SL 2 = slave, auto, soun)/bLnd (no-signal behaviour). Online 'LED Beam 90W' charts with pan/tilt fine channels do NOT match this unit. Speed (pan 120, tilt 90 deg/s at XY speed 0) is an ESTIMATE: on 2026-10-31 the owner saw the beams relight while still moving; time a full pan to refine.

color_auto.notes: built-in colour cycling; keep 0 under DMX

reset.notes: high values reset the head (~5 s dark)
